reviews.title: Very Disappointed – Watch Faces Don’t Work on Apple Watch Ultra 1
reviews.text:
I bought this app for £19.99 after seeing an exciting ad. Unfortunately, the live watch faces didn’t work on my Apple Watch Ultra 1 despite troubleshooting. I’ve requested a refund from Apple, which I hope to receive soon. I’m disappointed because the watch faces looked great, and I rarely spend money on apps. Hopefully, the developers can fix the issue so that future buyers don’t experience this problem.

EDIT: Thanks for your response. I had already followed the troubleshooting steps like turning off the always-on feature and restating my watch but nothing worked. I deleted the app and received my refund from Apple a while ago. Hopefully you can fix these issues for future users, as the watch faces look like they would be fantastic if they worked.

reviews.text: This app provides quantity over quality. The animations are very brief then the screen zooms. Among all the choices I really couldn’t find anything I liked more than the Snoopy watch face that came with the watch. IMO the gallery that comes with the watch is superior, especially with the ability to use your own photo. Don’t waste your money
